text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Super Creek finishes the race while<n>still in poor
condition.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Upon finishing the race, her health<n>takes a turn for
the worse, and she<n>collapses.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
A campus doctor gives her a quick<n>examination but
is unable to<n>determine the cause of her illness,
cautioning her to forgo the spring<n>Classic races.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
She weeps over not being able to<n>deliver her
promised victories, and we<n>tentatively set the fall
Kikuka Sho as<n>her next goal.
